senses.gloss: वल् short term (प्रत्याहार) for consonants excepting य्: cf. लोपो व्योर्वलि P. VI. 1.66; आर्धधातुकस्येड् वलादेः P. VII.2.35.

वल (l) tad. caturarthika affix वलच् applied to the word शिखा in the four senses country and others;e.g. शिखावलं नगरं देशो वा Kas.on P.IV.2.89; (2) tad. affix वल in the sense of possession applied to words रजस्, कृषि and others as also to दन्त and शिखा when the word is used as a proper noun ( संज्ञा ) and to the word ऊर्जस्: e.g. रजस्वला, कृषीवल:, ऊर्जखल: etc.; cl. रजःकृष्यासुतिपरिषदो वलच्, दन्तशिखात्संज्ञायाम् and ज्योत्स्ना ... ऊर्जस्वल ..मलीमसा: P. V. 2.112, 113, 114.
वल्लभ named हरिवल्लभ also,who wrote a commentary on Nagesa's Sabd- endusekhara.
